items.title: Show HN: AgentMall – Let your AI agent buy groceries
items.summary: Hey HN, we’re Nel and Kosi. We noticed personal agents like Instinct, Muse were terrible at buying stuff. Most of the time the checkout would fail. So we built reliable automations for agents to checkout at 9 leading grocery merchants. We grapple with anti bot, logins, OTP codes, and changing checkout structures. Loved revisiting this stuff given our backgrounds sneaker-botting and building computer use models. Honestly full circle haha. It currently works on these sites with ~70% checkout success rate: - Walmart - Albertsons - Ocado - Wegmans - FreshDirect - Best Buy - Instacart Our goal is to hill climb to 90%+ across each. Test keys are free and run the real flow without placing an order. New accounts get 10 free completed orders. https://docs.getagentmall.com/quickstart

items.title: Releasing Typemaid on NPM Turning your mermaid diagrams into AI workflows
items.summary: I've been privately building a TypeScript SDK called TypeMaid and using it for my own projects over the past month. It's based on Typed DAGs, with Mermaid diagrams to define and visualize AI workflows. I've found this approach surprisingly simple to understand and work with, especially compared to writing workflows entirely in code. I recently open-sourced it and am now working on durability, retries, and persistent execution. I'm curious what others think about using Mermaid to define executable AI workflows. Does this approach make sense, or am I missing something? Would really appreciate any feedback, suggestions, or contributions! Star on github https://github.com/typemaid/typemaid

items.title: Preview seed fixture (rolling)
items.summary: Rolling, fully SYNTHETIC preview-database seed fixture baked from dev@6a42315fec58 (migration head: 20261112120000_account_deletion_confirmation_skipped). Preview environments restore fixture.dump.gz (custom-format, gzipped, platform schema only, including _prisma_migrations) BEFORE running a PR's own migrations, so schema changes run against populated tables. RESTORE: apply restore-preamble.sql to the target database first (it creates the platform schema and installs the vector + pg_trgm extensions into it, which pg_dump --schema=platform omits), then run 'gunzip -c fixture.dump.gz | pg_restore -d --no-owner' WITHOUT --exit-on-error (the dump's own CREATE SCHEMA collides benignly with the preamble's). SECURITY INVARIANT: this bake holds no cloud credentials and has no read path to any real database — it runs entirely against a throwaway Postgres container and contains only synthetic rows (Faker-generated, plus the hand-written preview marketplace) and the already-public marketplace agent exports checked into autogpt_platform/backend/agents/. This asset is regenerated on every eligible dev push and weekly; treat it as disposable.

items.title: Vercel Billing CLI is now available
items.summary: You can now check your team’s billing overview, review and download invoices, and preview upcoming charges with the Vercel CLI . All billing commands, including usage, contracts, and budgets, are now grouped under vercel billing . Billing overview and invoice history are available on all plans, subject to your team’s existing billing permissions. Upcoming invoice estimates require an active paid subscription. Billing overview Check your team’s plan, billing status, billing cycle, balance due, and overdue invoices: In CLI 65.17.0 and later, this overview also includes configured invoice details such as your billing address, tax ID, and purchase order. Invoices and upcoming charges Use vercel billing invoices to review invoices, download PDFs, and preview upcoming charges. For inspect and download , replace with a full invoice ID from the list output: Upcoming charges are estimates and may change until the end of the billing period. For scripts and agents, add --json to vercel billing overview or any vercel billing invoices subcommand for structured output. Existing usage, contract, and budget commands now also use the same prefix: vercel usage → vercel billing usage vercel contract → vercel billing contract vercel budgets → vercel billing budgets The previous command names continue to work as aliases. To get started, update your Vercel CLI with vercel upgrade . Learn more in the Billing & Invoices documentation .
items.summary_html:
You can now check your team’s billing overview, review and download invoices, and preview upcoming charges with the Vercel CLI. All billing commands, including usage, contracts, and budgets, are now grouped under vercel billing.

Billing overview and invoice history are available on all plans, subject to your team’s existing billing permissions. Upcoming invoice estimates require an active paid subscription.

Billing overview

Check your team’s plan, billing status, billing cycle, balance due, and overdue invoices:

In CLI 65.17.0 and later, this overview also includes configured invoice details such as your billing address, tax ID, and purchase order.

Invoices and upcoming charges

Use vercel billing invoices to review invoices, download PDFs, and preview upcoming charges. For inspect and download, replace with a full invoice ID from the list output:

Upcoming charges are estimates and may change until the end of the billing period.

For scripts and agents, add --json to vercel billing overview or any vercel billing invoices subcommand for structured output.

Existing usage, contract, and budget commands now also use the same prefix:

  • vercel usage → vercel billing usage

  • vercel contract → vercel billing contract

  • vercel budgets → vercel billing budgets

The previous command names continue to work as aliases.

To get started, update your Vercel CLI with vercel upgrade. Learn more in the Billing & Invoices documentation.

items.title: Madras School System and AI Learning Share Similarity
items.summary: Madras School education system (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madras_School) that was the bedrock of mass public structured education in the late 18-19th century has several similarities on how AI is trained today. They both ensures that knowledge dissemination is free. The similarities they share are as follows 1) Madras school & AI distillation (Teacher-Student models) encourages Students to teach others instead of just teachers thereby reducing cost. 2) Madras school & Reinforcement learning rewards or awards penalty scores based on the assessment/feedback. 3) Both systems ultimately ended in rote learning and hallucinations. The other day when I noticed that several leading professors of top universities were sharing their top courses for free on YT. I immediately remembered our education system (Madras School) and how it had a profound impact in today's education system especially public mass elementary schooling system. It is also notable that today's AI training took a leaf out of it. Those professors were indeed trying to bring Madras school system to the Universities by free knowledge dissemination that too in this AI era, which is commendable. But the current commercial education system is a stark difference from the Madras school which was designed for the mass and was affordable. But today's education and research is full of competition and highly unaffordable which was not the case in the early 19th century. Finally, I would like to conclude that the commercial education (training teachers) and proprietary SOTA frontier models both gate keep their highest tier capabilities behind high tuition or API paywalls, whereas open weights models and the Madras System prioritize broad, low cost knowledge dissemination.
items.summary_html:
Madras School education system (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madras_School) that was the bedrock of mass public structured education in the late 18-19th century has several similarities on how AI is trained today.

They both ensures that knowledge dissemination is free.

The similarities they share are as follows

1) Madras school & AI distillation (Teacher-Student models) encourages Students to teach others instead of just teachers thereby reducing cost.

2) Madras school & Reinforcement learning rewards or awards penalty scores based on the assessment/feedback.

3) Both systems ultimately ended in rote learning and hallucinations.

The other day when I noticed that several leading professors of top universities were sharing their top courses for free on YT. I immediately remembered our education system (Madras School) and how it had a profound impact in today's education system especially public mass elementary schooling system. It is also notable that today's AI training took a leaf out of it. Those professors were indeed trying to bring Madras school system to the Universities by free knowledge dissemination that too in this AI era, which is commendable.

But the current commercial education system is a stark difference from the Madras school which was designed for the mass and was affordable. But today's education and research is full of competition and highly unaffordable which was not the case in the early 19th century.

Finally, I would like to conclude that the commercial education (training teachers) and proprietary SOTA frontier models both gate keep their highest tier capabilities behind high tuition or API paywalls, whereas open weights models and the Madras System prioritize broad, low cost knowledge dissemination.

items.title: Ask HN: What positive impact has AI had in the past 5 years?
items.summary: I asked myself this question this morning and I swear I couldn't find one single thing. We still have all the problems we had before AI. AI did not solve the climate collapse, did not cure cancer, did not figure society-altering new technologies, did not make politics not suck anymore, did not solve our anxieties... If anything, we're all just more anxious today. It succeeded at making my work toxic because of the cyber warfare paranoia, I guess. AI successfully blew and continues to blow all the benchmarks it's been trained to blow. It makes long mathematical proofs nobody can read or verify about problems nobody cares about. Great? So… can someone list things that AI has genuinely improved? If there are none, why do we tolerate it?

items.title: Show HN: Disposable – Share small AI-made tools so others can rebuild them
items.summary: I made a site for sharing small tools made with AI. With agents, it is now quick to build a tool that fits your own task. But those tools usually get thrown away after use, and the next person who may needs something similar start again from zero. So I thought maybe if result or process could shared by text or code and this can lead to kind of token sharing economy. Its name is Disposable and compared to "Open source", I named its philosophy to "Open Disposable". So the principle is "Like open source, without the upkeep. Keep the know-how, rebuild the tool your way". You can share anything you actually used and found useful, with no promise to maintain it. Others can use it as is, or give the spec that comes with it to theur own agent and have it rebuilt. If you have your own skill, prompt, or program you would like to show others, please share it. If you get stuck while sharing, let me know. Repo: https://github.com/x-ify/disposable
